expectations.text: Plan explores what causes the addition_position_preserved failure — not just where to add a fix but why it fails
expectations.evidence: Context section explains the 3-step causal chain: (1) '_extract_placeholder' emits ADDITION token even in IGNORE context, (2) migration suppresses the placeholder so V2 has no matching addition, (3) PositionPreservedAxiom finds unmatched V1 addition and raises a violation. Root cause traced to the cb77627 refactor removing inherited_type handling.

suggestions.assertion: Every implementation task includes a test scaffold block showing fixture/container setup and arrange/act/assert skeleton
suggestions.reason: The assertion could be strengthened to also require that the scaffold be non-trivial — i.e., contains at least one concrete assert statement. Task 3 satisfied the letter of the requirement with a comment-only block, which would also pass a naive check. A discriminating version might require: 'each scaffold has at least one assert statement or function definition'.

No assertion checks whether the root-cause explanation identifies the specific commit (cb77627) or the exact method responsible. The plan does include this level of detail, but the current assertions don't distinguish between a shallow 'it fails because X' and a deep causal chain explanation.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are well-targeted and mostly discriminating. The main gap is assertion 8, which a plan can technically satisfy with a placeholder scaffold block containing only comments. The root-cause assertion (6) is strong and was genuinely satisfied with detail.
